reason: First new C1 BOS run failed the absolute 780 ms threshold, but the prelisted continuous binary AUC was 0.9062 and four-class T2 was 8/32. A fresh matched C0/C1 BOS comparison is needed before a scheduler-dependence claim.
shared: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, vLLM 0.17.1, prefix caching on, existing BOS W=4, 16 output tokens, 10 ms send stagger
cases_per_condition: 32 positive groups, 8 per warm send position, and 4 no-warm controls
randomization: same independently shuffled case sequence in both conditions; distinct salt tags and fresh engine start per condition
attacker_inputs: own request parameters, IDs, send order, and complete client receive times; no backend/proxy/cache fields
primary_comparisons: Four-class T2 and RT accuracy under C0 versus C1, each StandardScaler plus LogisticRegression(C=1) trained on 32 balanced old groups of its own configuration; continuous AUC of Tblock for C1 position 1 versus positions 2-4
secondary: R1, R2, T1, binary AUC under C0, old 780 ms threshold under C1, and frozen direct pair-gap rule applied diagnostically to BOS
decision_guide: A clear contrast requires C0 T2 at least 20/32, C1 T2 at most 12/32, and C1 binary AUC at least 0.8. Failure does not prove BOS security; report all metrics and uncertainty. Stop after these two conditions.
integrity: Require 36 complete groups and 144 HTTP-200 responses per condition, 544 cached tokens on exactly one warm probe per positive group, full BOS W=4 groups, no client-visible cache diagnostic
causal_limit: Case sequence is paired, but engine configurations run in successive sessions rather than simultaneous or randomized crossover. Backend/Proxy times explain mechanisms only.
